releases.title: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 (open weights, MIT) + Search & Fetch APIs
releases.summary: A minor update to DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash with gains in reasoning, coding, agentic and visual benchmarks (DeepSeek reports DeepSWE v1.1 77.0, up from 74.2; Terminal-Bench 4.0 42.3, up from 31.2) plus shorter outputs and faster task runs. Live on DeepSeek's website, app and API under the same deepseek-flash name at unchanged prices; MIT-licensed weights on Hugging Face and ModelScope. DeepSeek also opened its in-house Search & Fetch APIs to everyone at $0.75 per 1,000 calls per endpoint.

releases.title: REA /reverse-engineer skill in Perplexity Computer
releases.summary: Computer can now use REA (Reverse Engineer Anything), morluto's open-source MIT-licensed toolkit, to inspect how an app works without its source code and then build a working version. Tasks that use /reverse-engineer are free through Oct 31, up to 10,000 credits per user. Announced on Perplexity's official Computer account on X.

releases.title: Glimpse (visual thinking model)
releases.summary: Elorian's first model reasons over images and video: tracking objects through motion, reasoning from other viewpoints and predicting physical consequences, with multimodal tools and subagents. Available today via API and Elorian's chat UI at $0.60 / $3.00 per 1M input/output tokens; benchmarks are Elorian's own.

releases.title: RTX Spark laptops go on sale
releases.summary: Windows laptops built on NVIDIA's RTX Spark superchip (Blackwell RTX GPU + Grace CPU) with up to 128GB of unified memory and up to 1 petaflop of FP4 AI compute, aimed at local AI models and agents, creative apps and gaming. Available from ASUS, Dell, HP, Lenovo, Microsoft and MSI, starting at $2,599; pricing varies by region.

releases.title: Cline Cloud sessions (v4.1.25)
releases.summary: Cline can now run a task in a hosted sandbox on a GitHub repo and branch you pick; cloud tasks show in Recent and History, notify you when they finish, and keep running after you close your editor. Rolling out gradually.

releases.title: Beam 1.0 (open weights, Apache 2.0)
releases.summary: Reflection's first open-weight model: a 501B-total / 23B-active MoE with a 1M-token context, built for coding, reasoning and agentic work. Weights in BF16, FP8 and NVFP4 on Hugging Face; also on Reflection's API and partners including Ollama, LM Studio, OpenRouter and OpenCode.

releases.title: SPACE sandbox platform open-sourced (Apache 2.0)
releases.summary: SPACE, the sandbox platform that runs every Perplexity Computer session, is now open source: isolated Firecracker microVMs with pause/resume, snapshots, session branching, and network and credential controls kept outside the sandbox. Akamai, Crusoe and CoreWeave are offering or documenting deployments.

releases.title: FLUX 3 Image Klein (open weights)
releases.summary: A 5.6B-parameter open-weight image model for text-to-image, editing and multi-reference generation (up to 10 reference images), with native 4K output and bounding-box layout control. Weights on Hugging Face under the FLUX Kommunity License; also on the BFL API.

releases.title: Krea 3
releases.summary: Krea's new image-editing model for production work: most edits return in under 8 seconds at native 2K, with characters and products kept consistent across references. Live on krea.ai and via fal, Replicate, OpenRouter, Together AI and others.

releases.title: GPT-Live-1.1 (ChatGPT Voice)
releases.summary: Updated voice model for ChatGPT Voice with more natural accents and new voices in French, German, Hindi, Japanese, Korean and Mexican Spanish. Availability varies by region and account.

releases.title: Muse Spark Open (open weights)
releases.summary: Meta's open-weight multimodal MoE: 816B total / 42B active parameters, 1M-token context, built for coding and agentic work. Weights on Hugging Face; runs locally on M5 Ultra Mac Studios via MLX, plus vLLM, SGLang and llama.cpp; hosted on OpenRouter, Groq, Together and others.

releases.title: Nemotron 3.5 Super VL and Bolt
releases.summary: Open models for agents: Super VL (120B) for servers, Bolt 74B-A9B sized for 24GB local machines with llama.cpp, Ollama, LM Studio and vLLM support. A 4GB Bolt E4B is due Oct 23.

releases.title: Code Review GA for Claude Team and Enterprise
releases.summary: Automated GitHub pull-request reviews leave research preview; most finish in 6-10 minutes, with Quick, Standard or Deep settings per repo. Eligible Enterprise orgs can claim credits through Jan 15, 2027.

releases.title: Deep Review (public release)
releases.summary: Agentic system that checks technical documents (papers, Docs, slides) for grounded, rigorous feedback. Two free reviews per week; heavier use via your Gemini API key.

releases.title: Gemini 4 Argon
releases.summary: Google's latest frontier model, aimed at hard coding, science and agentic work with a 1M-token limit. Available via API, Antigravity (Ultra), and the Gemini app (Ultra/Pro). Intro price $2/$10 per 1M tokens until Nov 30.

releases.title: Claude Haiku 5.5
releases.summary: Anthropic's cheapest, fastest small model. Sonnet 5.5 cache reads also halved in price, and Max/Team plans get monthly API credits.

releases.title: GPT-6 with Intelligent UI in ChatGPT
releases.summary: GPT-6 Sol (paid) and Luna (Free/Go) arrive in ChatGPT Chat, answering with interactive UIs. Rollout to paid tiers started Oct 7, Free/Go the next day.

releases.title: dots (cloud-computer agents)
releases.summary: Always-on personal agents rolling out in ChatGPT to Pro and Business Premium users in eligible markets.

releases.title: Claude Opus 5.5
releases.summary: First of the Claude 5.5 family: long-running agentic coding and knowledge work, $4/$20 per 1M tokens, 1M context. Fast mode available in Claude Code.

releases.title: Grok 4.7
releases.summary: Flagship for coding and knowledge work; 500k context, $2/$6 per 1M tokens on the API. Available in Cursor and Grok Build.

releases.title: Agents API (public beta)
releases.summary: Brings the Codex harness and infrastructure to developers via API; pay only for tokens and tools used.

releases.title: Muse personal agent
releases.summary: Meta's personal AI agent for everyday tasks, in a Muse app, WhatsApp and the web. Date per secondary coverage; link is AP News.

releases.title: Projects (beta)
releases.summary: A coordinator agent delegates long-running work to cloud subagents; can subscribe to Slack, PRs and schedules. Exact day not confirmed (September per secondary timeline).
